rows.note: Use this when the permission is someone’s agreement or consent, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: I still haven't got my family's permission, so I don't dare sign up.
example.traditional: 我仲未攞到屋企人嘅同意，唔敢報名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 lo2 dou2 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 tung4 ji3 m4 gam2 bou3 meng2

rows.note: Use this when permission means official approval that must be obtained from an authority.

example.english: This application is still waiting for the supervisor's permission.
example.traditional: 呢份申請仲等緊上級批准。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 san1 cing2 zung6 dang2 gan2 soeng6 kap1 pai1 zeon2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose formal noun for authorisation or permission, especially in official contexts.

example.english: You cannot enter the construction site without the department's permission.
example.traditional: 未經部門許可，唔可以進入工地。
example.jyutping: mei6 ging1 bou6 mun4 heoi2 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon3 jap6 gung1 dei6
